rules.requires: local sid,id6 CSV; skipped if absent

form_chain: fill username + passwordText, dispatch input/change/keyup/blur, click a#login_submit (saltPassword is computed in click handler)
real_failure_text: 您提供的用户名或者密码有误 (regex-fixed after first attempt was missed)
trial: D01 under R2 -> failed and written back; switching to R3 triggered captcha -> stopped for human
limits: 3 sourced rules only, no brute force; max 5 consecutive attempts; stop on hit/lock/forced-change/captcha; no post-login data; plaintext passwords never logged
boundary: CSV with real student IDs and optional ID6 CSV stay local only
